description_en: Modifies the binding information of a landline AXB privacy number
description_zh: 修改固话AXB隐私号绑定信息
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi update-axb-bind-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --sub-id A100000000000000000 --order-id 1230000000 --subts 20161114143116 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAxbBindFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp in the format of yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
Sets number A in the binding relationship.


Number A can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. Landline numbers must include the area code, with no hyphen between the area code and the number.
TelA and TelB cannot be updated at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
设置绑定关系中的 A 号码。


A 号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
TelA，TelB不允许同时更新
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
Sets number B in the binding relationship.


Number B can be set to a mobile phone number or a landline number. Landline numbers must include the area code, with no hyphen between the area code and the number.
TelA and TelB cannot be updated at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
对设置绑定关系中的 B 号码。


B 号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
TelA，TelB不允许同时更新
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en: The binding time in the format of yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
The ringback tone code for the caller side. This parameter must be set for the landline AXB privacy number service. The tone code must contain codes for three scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

"1,2,3" indicates that the tone code for B->X is 1, the tone code for A->X is 2, and the tone code for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，固话AXB隐私号业务时必须设置。放音编码必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
The ringback tone code for the called side after the call is connected. The called-side tone code must contain codes for two scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the tone code when number A is the called party is 1, and the tone code when number B is the called party is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，被叫放音编码必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
The ringback tone code for the caller side after the call is connected. The tone code must contain codes for two scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as called party, B as called party", separated by commas.

"1,2" indicates that the tone code for the caller side when number A is the called party is 1, and the tone code for the caller side when number B is the called party is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，接通后主叫侧放音编码必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

“1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time, in seconds. Valid values:

0: never expires.

Other values: when other values are specified, such as 60s, the binding is valid for 60 seconds after number X is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

0：永不过期。

其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: An external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable call recording. Valid values:

0 (default): recording disabled.

1: recording enabled
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

0（默认值）：不录音。

1：录音
fields.name: callrecording
